lesson.title: Bitcoin as Temporal Anchor
lesson.topic: Understanding how Bitcoin's blockchain provides a reliable timestamping mechanism that serves as an anchor for time-based systems and agreements.
lesson.steelman: How does the concept of 'time anchoring' in Bitcoin enhance the reliability and trustworthiness of digital transactions?
lesson.example: Exploring how Timestamp Service (taal) uses Bitcoin's blockchain to verify and timestamp documents, ensuring their integrity over time.

rationale: This lesson highlights the less-discussed but crucial aspect of Bitcoin's role in establishing a universal, tamper-proof timeline.
